title: Rohan's idea
body: Rohan, a 24-year-old graduate from a small town, noticed that farmers nearby threw away banana stems after harvest. He had an idea to turn the fibre into mats and bags. He owned no land, machinery or savings. He prepared a project plan, convinced a bank to sanction a loan, rented a shed, signed contracts for the supply of a fibre-extraction machine, electricity and water, and hired six women from the village whom he trained. Before resigning from his salaried job he estimated his likely costs, sales and income for the first two years.
